title: 约翰霍普金斯专家：麻疹病例创30年新高，疫苗率下降能否阻止传播？
speaker: Dr. Amish Adolgez

segments.en: In less cheerful news and alarming statistics from the CDC on Friday, the number of measles cases this year in the United States hit 2,318.
segments.zh: CDC周五发布令人担忧的数据，今年美国麻疹病例已达2318例。

segments.en: That's higher than all of last year and is now the most infection since 1991.
segments.zh: 超过去年全年总数，创下1991年以来最高纪录。

segments.en: With measles, it's really a no-brainer. We got there because vaccination rates fell below the herd immunity threshold.
segments.zh: 麻疹问题很简单：疫苗接种率降至群体免疫阈值以下。

segments.en: And we're talking about what is the most contagious infectious disease that we humans face, one that requires a high level of immunity in the population, and one in which it's circulating in many parts of the world.
segments.zh: 麻疹是人类面临的最具传染性的疾病，需要高水平人群免疫，且在全球多地传播。

segments.en: So all it took was for us to lower our armor, to lower our force field, and then measles came back. It never went away.
segments.zh: 我们一旦降低防护，麻疹就卷土重来——它从未消失。

segments.en: And the solution is equally simple. It's just to get more vaccine into the arms of people who are unvaccinated and then this problem will disappear.
segments.zh: 解决方案同样简单：让未接种者接种疫苗，问题就会消失。
